title: Pinefall Modpack
description: A lightweight collection of quality-of-life and performance mods recommended for the Pinefall SMP experience.
body:
Pinefall Modpack is a curated collection of client side mods built to improve your experience on Pinefall SMP.

This pack focuses on performance improvements, FPS boosts, visual enhancements, and useful **quality of life** features. It does not change vanilla gameplay or add unfair advantages.

Everything included is designed to make Pinefall feel smoother, cleaner, and more responsive while keeping the core Vanilla experience intact.

Whether you are **building**, **grinding**, **fighting in KOTH**, or **exploring the custom Overworld**, **Nether**, **and End**, this modpack helps your game run better without changing how Pinefall is meant to be played.

Recommended for all Pinefall players.
